description: Core rule set for English-based compression in Flux System. Focus on clarity, minimalism, and semantic retention.

remove_articles.comment: Articles rarely affect meaning; remove them.

simplify_auxiliary_verbs.comment: Auxiliary verbs often redundant in summaries.

remove_redundant_phrases.pattern: \b(in order to|as well as|in the case of|due to the fact that)\b
remove_redundant_phrases.comment: Replace long forms with simpler equivalents or omit.

lowercase.comment: Convert all text to lowercase for consistency.
